files.role: OCR-parsed UFC official scorecard totals as published by UFC-DataLab

important_limitations: This file contains OCR-derived values, not hand-verified official scorecard transcription.
Observed sample rows include obvious fighter-pair/OCR association errors. No row is canonical until matched against the Greco fight table and validated.
The published file stores three judges' fight/elapsed totals per corner rather than a complete judge-by-round structured table.
Dash values occur for fights/rounds without score totals and must remain missing rather than becoming numeric zero.
Fighter names are not stable identifiers; canonical joins must use fight/date/opponent context and fail closed on ambiguity.
semantics.source_origin: UFC official scorecard images scraped and OCR-parsed by UFC-DataLab
